items.title: AstroGold: NOW on WINDOWS
items.summary:
You may have seen AstroGold astrology software on Mac, iOS or Android already.

AstroGold has now been written for Windows.

Rhonda works through the basic functions and settings of AstroGold Windows. AstroGold Win is of the same style as AG Mac, rich with the same interface and features, including Maps.

An AstroGold computer license will install on either Mac or Windows.

We tend to do what we do without taking time to explore things that the software will do for us which can lose us time and convenience. This session is a basic training and will highlight the features and functions, and help you get more from your app.

To view our current class offerings, visit: https://store.keplercollege.org/current-course-offerings/

To learn more about Rhonda's great work for the astrology community, visit: https://astrotech.com.au

items.title: The power of secondary progressions ⏱️ Secondary progressions are one of my favorite timing
items.summary:
The power of secondary progressions ⏱️ 

Secondary progressions are one of my favorite timing techniques for seeing how someone evolves over time. 

What to note 👇

1️⃣ The progressed moon

2️⃣ when planets enter new signs

3️⃣ when planets station direct or retrograde. 

For example, VENUS shows what you appreciate and what you’re drawn to. 

and your style and aesthetic completely changes when your progressed Venus shifts. 

When my progressed Venus was in Cancer I was all about minimalism, capsule wardrobes and earthy tones. 

The LITERAL month that my progressed Venus moved into Leo, my style became….different 🤣

Lots of colors. Lots of boldness. Lots of leopard prints. Lots of faux fur coats. 

This is the power of timing. 

And this technique is only ONE of *many* I’m teaching you step-by-step in my live Timing Certification happening this year. 

1️⃣ Not only do you get 12 live class calls with me over the first 6 months (everything is taught live with slides and chart examples) 

2️⃣ but in the second half of the program (the second 6 months) you’ll learn in break out study groups! Bring your charts, meet your peers and I’ll be answering all your questions 🌟

3️⃣ includes quizzes, a thorough test assessment on all the techniques at the end…(written assessment and 120 question multiple choice exam) 

4️⃣ Telegram group with all the students where you can get PEER support anytime 

5️⃣ Certification at the end when you pass + the opportunity to join my recommended reader list of certified students ⤵️

So you can start booking your own clients! ⏱️

items.title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio in History
items.summary:
A deep dive into the repeating eight-year historical cycles of Venus retrograde in Scorpio, to understand the recurring archetypal themes this transit brings to the surface.

During the course of the episode, I group together retrogrades that are archetypally similar in order to clearly illustrate the undeniable patterns that emerge when this cycle repeats.

Ultimately, analyzing this history provides us with a helpful framework for anticipating what will unfold during the current Venus retrograde in late 2026.

This is episode 549 of The Astrology Podcast.
